# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify the auditor's instructions and scope of work.
3. Review the audit checklist or standard.
4. Document all deviations from compliance.
5. Note any corrective actions requested by the auditor (if applicable).
6. Record non-conforming items: 

   a. Identify the issue.
   b. Provide photographic evidence if possible.
   c. Reference relevant safety regulations or guidelines.


7. List recommendations for improvement made during the audit.

8. Include the dates and times of the audit.

9. Document the names and titles of individuals present.

10. Detail the communication exchange and discussions with management.

11. Summarize any immediate impacts on operations and scheduling.

12. Document the final overall audit score/rating.

13. Record feedback, observations, and notes made by the auditor.

14. Include any comments or responses provided by the auditee.

15. Finally, prepare a corrective action plan:
